verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI assistant built into Algolia's dashboard or tools that a user can delegate tasks to. Agent Studio is a developer building block for creating end-user agents such as shopping assistants grounded in Algolia indices. The MCP server and agent skills serve external agents rather than providing an in-product assistant. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
